content.title: Artemis II Speed Explained: Why Astronauts Travel At Mach 32 | WION Podcast
content.text: In this episode, we explore the extreme speeds of NASA’s Artemis II mission and why astronauts will travel at a staggering Mach 32. From launch acceleration to the powerful re-entry phase, every moment pushes the limits of human spaceflight. Discover how physics, gravity, and advanced engineering make this journey possible. The mission highlights both the risks and brilliance behind deep space exploration.
